name: Edge-aware surface rendering for neural SDFs
definition: A rendering technique for neural Signed Distance Fields (SDFs) that correctly computes gradients at edge pixels by detecting 3D edge points, reparameterizing their location to allow back-propagation along the surface normal, and blending colors from disconnected surface pieces based on subpixel edge geometry.
summary: Edge-aware surface rendering for neural SDFs correctly computes gradients at depth discontinuities by detecting 3D edge points and blending colors, allowing topology changes that standard differentiable rendering cannot handle.
